string_format.description: Channel Mapping: A0 = NH3, A1 = H2S OP1 (WE), A2 = H2S OP2 (AE), A3 = VOC

calibration.note: Alphasense factory calibration only. Each gas uses only the zero and sensitivity printed on its Alphasense factory calibration sheet: H2S (ppb) = ((A1 - WE zero) - (A2 - AE zero)) / sensitivity; NH3 (ppm) = (A0 - WE zero) / sensitivity; VOC (ppm) = (A3 - V zero) / sensitivity. No temperature tables, filtering or smoothing. A gas with any value left null shows no number until its factory sheet is entered.

nh3.sheet_values: WE zero 328 mV; 73.28 nA/ppm x 0.8 mV/nA (ISB gain) = 58.624 mV/ppm
